recentItems.title: GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto 6) - Official Global Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
Take a look at the Global Launch Trailer for GTA 6, the latest entry in the third-person open-world action-adventure Grand Theft Auto franchise developed by Rockstar Games. Players can get a new look at the highly anticipated title as Jason and Lucia navigate a life of crime with romance in the mix. Explore Vice City and all Leonida has to offer in Grand Theft Auto 6, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #Gaming

recentItems.title: GTA 6’s First Two Hours Teach You Everything You Need to Know About The Next 100
recentItems.description:
GTA 6’s open world is one packed full of distractions. 

After its short prologue and quick drug-running operation around the fictional Florida Keys, you wake up as Jason, ready to continue his crime-centred day job as a collections man for his boss, Brian. Three different main mission markers are then offered to you, ushering you into the familiar GTA rhythm you’ll likely spend much of the next 100 hours moving to. But the real beauty of what makes this game so special is the unpredictability of what happens in between those major moments, and the choices you make both in and out of missions. 

This is how the first two hours teaches you everything you need to know about the next 100 hours in GTA 6.

recentItems.title: Stay Human! - Official Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Stay Human!, an upcoming chaotic co-op ambulance simulator set during a zombie apocalypse. Stay Human! will be available on PC.

In Stay Human!, every call is a race through a city crawling with zombies. Your driving can make or break the rescue. Knock zombies out of the way and dodge obstacles. Take a corner too hard? Your teammate doing CPR won't thank you for that. Hit the antidote injector? You might speed up the bitten patient's transformation instead. Your job is to get the patient to the hospital before they become a zombie.

#IGN #Gaming

recentItems.title: GTA 6: What Are Illegal Operations?
recentItems.description:
Illegal Operations are GTA 6's version of bandit camps, offering opportunities to take down rival gangs, collect valuable loot, and make some easy money. But what exactly are these activities, what rewards can you find, and which ones should you tackle early in the game?

In this GTA 6 guide, we explain how Illegal Operations work, including the valuable loot you can find, how to know when you've collected everything, and why stealth can be a better approach than going in guns blazing. We'll also highlight two early Illegal Operations worth checking out: Strange Noises in Key Lento and Fishing Shacks near Cottonmouth Lake. Plus, we'll explain how the game's opening mission, Gone Fishing, introduces you to these activities.

For more help exploring Leonida, check out IGN's GTA 6 Strategy Guide at IGN.com for interactive maps, collectible locations, secrets, and more. https://www.ign.com/gta

recentItems.title: GTA 6: Best Early Weapons You Can Get for FREE (No Spoilers!)
recentItems.description:
Looking to expand your arsenal early in GTA 6 without spending a fortune at Ammu-Nation? There are several powerful Unique Weapon Variants hidden throughout Key Lento and the surrounding areas that you can pick up for free, giving you access to shotguns, sniper rifles, revolvers, assault rifles, and even a .50 Cal Pistol.

In this GTA 6 guide, we'll show you where to find some of the best free early weapons, including the Unpacked Comshot 12 Shotgun, Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 Sniper Rifle, Swamp Bait Akulus Revolver, Drug Mule KZ-59 Assault Rifle, Conspiracist Type 9 Machine Pistol, and Convict Kalings .50 Cal Pistol. We'll also show you where to find the Hauners H-AT Launcher.

Whether you're looking for more firepower to tackle Illegal Operations or just want to build up your arsenal without spending money, these are some of the best weapons to grab early in GTA 6.

recentItems.title: You Have to Become a Complete Psychopath to Get A 6 Star Wanted Level in GTA 6
recentItems.description:
Following a brief dip down to 5 stars in GTA 5, the full six-star wanted level system is back in GTA 6. As you begin your new criminal adventure, you might be wondering exactly what you need to do to trigger the largest police response to your fiendish Vice City activities. How do you hit the full 6 stars?

The short answer is: become a psychopath. The longer answer is a little more complicated, requires quite a bit of effort, and arguably involves relinquishing each of your morals one by one. Here’s how I got a six-star wanted level in GTA 6.

recentItems.title: GTA 6 - How to Become a Backyard Wrestler
recentItems.description: Looking to live out the fantasy of being a professional wrestler in Grand Theft Auto 6? Look no further than the Backyard American Mania wrestling ring, hidden in a backyard in Hamlet, and guarded by the fearsome Gentrifier. Check out this quick video showcasing the location of the ring, how to survive the Gentrifier's onslaught, and the rewards that await.
